title: Where a fast sampler misses the turn
idea: Follow 800 samples through exact 2D fields. Switch flow/ODE/SDE, Euler/Heun, 4–128 steps and three distributions. Export your settings as a GIF.
connection: FlashRender (3 Sep): sampling discretization and camera control. ViRDM (24 Sep): preserving motion during few-step post-training. Mechanism illustration, not paper reproduction.

title: 3D Gaussian splatting: projection & opacity
idea: Orbit a camera around colored ellipsoids; adjust covariance and opacity to see projected footprints blend.
connection: Connect to VS-Splat and sparse-view reconstruction.

title: Identity versus motion conditioning
idea: Switch appearance and motion reference channels independently in a labeled temporal diagram.
connection: Connect to BEACON without implying full-film consistency.

title: Audio tokens, timing and prosody
idea: Inspect text-to-codebook alignment and a synthetic timeline; vary pause duration and pitch contours.
connection: Connect to StepAudio 3 Gen and long-form TTS reliability.

title: Attention across space and time
idea: Show how a token reads frames, spatial patches and text; compare causal and sparse masks.
connection: Extend the current matrix into a video-attention view.

title: When good-looking frames still have weak motion
idea: Separate per-frame appearance statistics from temporal differences; let users build a clip with identical frame statistics but different motion.
connection: ViRDM (24 Sep) adds dynamics regularization because representation matching can underconstrain motion.
